title: Local depth formula expressed at a prime of the fibre ring
statement: Let R and S be commutative Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], with a flat R-algebra structure [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Let p be a prime of R, C = p.Fiber S = kappa(p) tensor_R S, Q a prime of C, and q its inverse image under S -> C. Localizations and fibre rings are as in [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Then depth(S_q) = depth(R_p) + depth(C_Q). Depth is defined by [def-weil-pbc-depth].

source.place: Proof of Tag 0339, with Tags 0337, 00ON, and Remark 0H9M; the fibre identifications are Mathlib Ideal.Fiber.algEquivAux₂.

proof.text: Put q = Q.comap(includeRight). Since Q lies over p and includeRight is an R-algebra homomorphism, q lies over p. The induced R_p -> S_q map is flat and local, with Noetherian local source and target.

Apply the flat local depth formula to get depth(S_q) = depth(R_p) + depth(S_q/I), where I is the image of the maximal ideal of R_p. Since that maximal ideal is pR_p, ideal map composition and the scalar tower identity show I = pS_q.
Mathlib Ideal.Fiber.algEquivAux₂ identifies C_Q with S_q / (pS)S_q; ideal map composition identifies this ideal with pS_q and hence I.

Depth is invariant under a local-ring isomorphism: its image maps the maximal ideal onto the maximal ideal. Map each regular sequence by the ring equivalence. Mathlib AddEquiv.isRegular_congr preserves regularity; list mapping preserves length. Apply this in both directions to show equality of the sets of lengths and their suprema. The maximal ideal times the ring is proper, so the exceptional infinity branch of Ideal.depth does not occur. Substitute the depth equality in step 2.

lean.statement:
theorem depth_eq_add_of_flat_fiber {R : Type u} {S : Type v}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing S]
    [Algebra R S] (hflat : (algebraMap R S).Flat)
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] (Q : Ideal (p.Fiber S)) [Q.IsPrime] :
    IsLocalRing.depth (R := Localization.AtPrime
        (Q.comap Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom))
      (Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom)) =
    IsLocalRing.depth (R := Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime p) +
      IsLocalRing.depth (R := Localization.AtPrime Q) (Localization.AtPrime Q)
